title: How a timed practice test is scored
body_html: The pass mark you see is the official passing score from the vendor, not a site invention. We do not convert scores to a different scale unless the vendor publishes that scale. Item types are scored as the site's question-type registry describes (for example, exact option set for multiple-select, and per-row answers for a yes/no grid). Unscored or held items are never mixed in silently. A practice result is practice only; it is not an official exam result.
